title: The boot budget re-measured after the 1835 townspeople's comings and goings
items: The first visit to the 1835 street now downloads 45.4 MB, 0.5 MB more than two days ago. Most of it is the 1835 townspeople's days, who goes in and out of which door and who is inside a house or shop, with the new carriage ride, the Today window and the people's dress. The budget moves to 45.7 MB, with what grew written down file by file, so every pull request's build can go green again.
